post.summary: Send an email to one or more recipients.
post.description:
By default, this method sends the email synchronously and returns a result only
 after the upstream provider has accepted it.

 For better performance with large attachments or batch sending, set `async: true`
 to queue the email for background processing.

connect-protocol-version.title: Connect-Protocol-Version
connect-protocol-version.description: Define the version of the Connect protocol

code.description: The status code, which should be an enum value of [google.rpc.Code][google.rpc.Code].

message.description: A developer-facing error message, which should be in English. Any user-facing error message should be localized and sent in the [google.rpc.Status.details][google.rpc.Status.details] field, or localized by the client.

details.description: A list of messages that carry the error details. There is no limit on the number of messages.

type.description: A URL that acts as a globally unique identifier for the type of the serialized message. For example: `type.googleapis.com/google.rpc.ErrorInfo`. This is used to determine the schema of the data in the `value` field and is the discriminator for the `debug` field.

value.description: The Protobuf message, serialized as bytes and base64-encoded. The specific message type is identified by the `type` field.

debug.title: Debug
debug.description: Deserialized error detail payload. The 'type' field indicates the schema. This field is for easier debugging and should not be relied upon for application logic.

connect.error_details.Any.description: Contains an arbitrary serialized message along with a @type that describes the type of the serialized message, with an additional debug field for ConnectRPC error details.

url.title: url
url.description: Publicly accessible URL to download the file from.

nameShort.title: name_short
nameShort.description: Shortened hostname (e.g. "email._domainkey" instead of full FQDN) for easier copy-pasting.

discoveredValue.title: discovered_value
discoveredValue.description: The value we actually found in your DNS (useful for debugging).

instructions.title: instructions
instructions.description: User-friendly instructions, e.g. "Add this TXT record to verify ownership".

summary.title: summary
summary.description: Simple summary of what's needed next.

message.title: message
message.description: A friendly message like "Add 3 DNS records to start sending".

nextAction.title: next_action
nextAction.description: Next logical step: "CONFIGURE_DNS", "WAIT" (for receiver cache), or "NONE" (done).

canSend.title: can_send
canSend.description: If true, you can start sending emails (even if not fully optimized).

canReceive.title: can_receive
canReceive.description: If true, you can receive inbound emails.

v1.EmailDelayedEvent.title: EmailDelayedEvent
v1.EmailDelayedEvent.description: Delivery is delayed but will be retried.

smtpResponse.title: smtp_response
smtpResponse.description: Detailed response from the SMTP server.

v1.EmailDeliveredEvent.title: EmailDeliveredEvent
v1.EmailDeliveredEvent.description: Email reached the recipient's mail server.

id.title: id
id.description: ID of this new inbound email.

inReplyTo.title: in_reply_to
inReplyTo.description: Message-ID of the email that was replied to.

parentEmailId.title: parent_email_id
parentEmailId.description: ID of the original email that was replied to (if found).

v1.EmailSentEvent.title: EmailSentEvent
v1.EmailSentEvent.description: Email was accepted and sent to the upstream provider.

v1.EmailStatus.title: EmailStatus
v1.EmailStatus.description: Represents the current status of an email delivery.

id.title: id
id.description: Unique event ID. Use this as a cursor to resume streaming.

v1.Event.title: Event
v1.Event.description: Event is the wrapper for all event payloads.

v1.EventType.title: EventType
v1.EventType.description: EventType defines the specific kind of event that occurred.

v1.RecordStatus.title: RecordStatus
v1.RecordStatus.description: Status of a single DNS record.

v1.RecordType.title: RecordType
v1.RecordType.description: Types of DNS records we require.

body.title: body
body.description: Plain text content. Always recommended for better deliverability.

metadata.title: metadata
metadata.description: Custom metadata to track this email. These values are returned in webhooks and events.

scheduledAt.title: scheduled_at
scheduledAt.description: Schedule this email for a future time (UTC).

inReplyTo.title: in_reply_to
inReplyTo.description:
Message-ID of the email to reply to. Setting this automatically handles
 threading headers (In-Reply-To, References).

references.title: references
references.description: Explicit threading references. Usually not needed if `in_reply_to` is set.

async.title: async
async.description:
Set to `true` to return immediately and send the email in the background.
 Recommended for bulk sending or when attachments are large.

id.title: id
id.description: Unique system ID for this email. Use this to track events.

cursor.title: cursor
cursor.description:
Checkpoint to resume streaming from.
 - Leave empty to start from *now* (live events only).
 - Set to "0" to read from the very beginning.
 - Set to a specific event ID to resume from that event.

wasRefreshed.title: was_refreshed
wasRefreshed.description: Whether we actually performed a fresh DNS lookup.

nextRetryAt.title: next_retry_at
nextRetryAt.description: When you can retry if rate limited.

tags.name: v1.DomainService
tags.description:
DomainService handles sending domains.
 To send emails with good deliverability, you need to:
 1. Add a domain (AddDomain)
 2. Configure the DNS records we give you
 3. Verify the layout (VerifyDomain)

tags.name: v1.EmailService
tags.description:
EmailService is the core service for sending emails and listening to events.
 It provides a simple, stateless API designed for developer happiness.
